name: Reacquire and verify a base backup
objective: Obtain a plain-format base-backup candidate with no reported manifest/file/checksum/required-WAL verification failures.
initial_test: On an immutable candidate, run version-compatible pg_verifybackup BACKUP_DIR, without --ignore, --skip-checksums or --no-parse-wal; record diagnostics and tool version.
exit_predicate: Fresh full verification completes without reported errors (including required WAL parsing); this is not proof of restorability.

procedure.operate_step: After investigating diagnostics and obtaining approval, acquire a new base backup using pg_basebackup into a new empty, separately provisioned directory; never overwrite, delete, or patch the failed backup.
procedure.retest: Invoke pg_verifybackup again against the newly acquired candidate and its manifest; capture new diagnostics rather than reusing the previous report.
stop_conditions: Exit only after a fresh, complete observation satisfies the exit predicate; an initial passing test may exit without operating.
Stop unresolved on missing permission, missing evidence, tool error, stagnation, oscillation, or exhausted max_iterations; never convert exhaustion into success.

name: Enable checksums on an approved offline cluster and verify
objective: For an approved, cleanly stopped offline cluster with disabled checksums, enable checksums and require a complete clean checksum scan.
initial_test: Require independently reviewed evidence of checksum configuration and clean shutdown. If checksums are enabled run pg_checksums --check -D CLUSTER_DIR; if disabled, mark target unmet without treating a disabled-checksum error as corruption.
exit_predicate: Fresh pg_checksums --check -D CLUSTER_DIR completes with exit status zero over the whole cluster; no --filenode narrowing.

procedure.operate_step: Only if independently confirmed disabled and explicitly authorized, run pg_checksums --enable -D CLUSTER_DIR in an isolated maintenance environment with all writers stopped and a protected backup. If checksums already enabled but failures exist, do not rewrite checksums: stop and escalate.
procedure.retest: After enable completes, freshly invoke pg_checksums --check -D CLUSTER_DIR; retain full diagnostics and exit status.
stop_conditions: Exit only after a fresh, complete observation satisfies the exit predicate; an initial passing test may exit without operating.
Stop unresolved on missing permission, missing evidence, tool error, stagnation, oscillation, or exhausted max_iterations; never convert exhaustion into success.

name: Convert a derivative and verify actual image format
objective: Produce a fully readable WebP derivative while preserving source and expected dimensions.
initial_test: Run magick identify +ping -verbose on the current derivative; inspect actual format, dimensions and corruption diagnostics against the author-approved delivery manifest.
exit_predicate: Fresh full-read identify report shows actual WEBP format, expected source dimensions and no decode/corruption diagnostics.

procedure.operate_step: From the preserved input, create a new uniquely named derivative using the documented conversion pattern magick input.png -quality 85 output.webp; do not overwrite originals. Quality 85 is the manual example, not a universal quality requirement.
procedure.retest: Run magick identify +ping -verbose on the new derivative, not the input or cached report; recheck actual format and dimensions.
stop_conditions: Exit only after a fresh, complete observation satisfies the exit predicate; an initial passing test may exit without operating.
Stop unresolved on missing permission, missing evidence, tool error, stagnation, oscillation, or exhausted max_iterations; never convert exhaustion into success.

name: Re-encode and remeasure reconstruction error
objective: Produce a WebP derivative satisfying a preapproved normalized RMSE threshold relative to a preserved reference.
initial_test: Confirm equal dimensions, page offsets, colorspace, channels, alpha and alignment before running magick compare -verbose -metric rmse REFERENCE CANDIDATE DIFF.png; record the normalized all-channel result and diagnostics.
exit_predicate: Fresh normalized all-channel RMSE is at or below the explicitly supplied project threshold, comparison finishes without errors, and human visual review accepts the derivative; absent threshold means unresolved.

procedure.operate_step: Choose one reviewed quality setting from a finite author-approved schedule and re-encode the preserved reference to a NEW WebP derivative using magick input.png -quality QUALITY output.webp. Preserve all originals and previous candidates.
procedure.retest: Repeat the same explicit-RMSE comparison on the newly encoded candidate, generating a new diagnostic/difference artifact; do not infer improvement from quality setting alone.
stop_conditions: Exit only after a fresh, complete observation satisfies the exit predicate; an initial passing test may exit without operating.
Stop unresolved on missing permission, missing evidence, tool error, stagnation, oscillation, or exhausted max_iterations; never convert exhaustion into success.

name: Review, revise and recheck page title
objective: Give one scoped page a brief descriptive title distinguishable from other scoped site pages.
initial_test: Inspect the page title using the documented Check page title bookmark procedure and compare its content description and distinctiveness against an explicitly enumerated site-page set.
exit_predicate: Fresh inspection shows a present, adequate brief description of current page content and a title distinct from every page in the declared comparison set, confirmed by reviewer.

procedure.operate_step: Have an authorized web editor revise the title to describe the page and distinguish it from other scoped pages, preferring important unique information first; deploy only through the approved site workflow.
procedure.retest: Reload the changed page and reapply the documented title check plus cross-page comparison on the new revision; capture fresh title text and reviewer decision.
stop_conditions: Exit only after a fresh, complete observation satisfies the exit predicate; an initial passing test may exit without operating.
Stop unresolved on missing permission, missing evidence, tool error, stagnation, oscillation, or exhausted max_iterations; never convert exhaustion into success.

name: Review, repair and recheck heading structure
objective: Make scoped page headings describe content and represent a coherent nested structure.
initial_test: Use the documented Check headings bookmark and compare its heading list with visible content: check presence, initial H1, skipped levels, blank headings, visually apparent headings absent from markup, and semantic fit.
exit_predicate: Fresh heading check finds headings, a starting H1, no blank headings or skipped subsection levels, no unmarked visual headings, and a reviewer confirms descriptive text and nesting matching the content.

procedure.operate_step: Have an authorized editor correct heading markup, rank, and text to match the actual content hierarchy; do not merely style ordinary text to look like headings.
procedure.retest: Reload the changed revision, invoke Check headings again and repeat all initial questions against both the fresh outline and visible page.
stop_conditions: Exit only after a fresh, complete observation satisfies the exit predicate; an initial passing test may exit without operating.
Stop unresolved on missing permission, missing evidence, tool error, stagnation, oscillation, or exhausted max_iterations; never convert exhaustion into success.
